# DevSwat

> Agentic AI infrastructure for building, running, and scheduling autonomous agents. Built-in IDE with AI intelligence, personalized chat with smart routing, AST/SAST code analysis, 9-layer semantic memory, and RARA governance. Connect any LLM provider. Fully self-hosted.

DevSwat is a full-stack agentic AI SaaS platform built from scratch. ~550K lines of code. Connect unlimited LLM providers and external platforms. Production-deployed at https://dev-swat.com.

## Core Products

- [Agents OS](https://dev-swat.com/agents): Build, run, and schedule autonomous AI agents on server or local hardware. Multi-agent orchestration with voting, debate, and chaining protocols.
- [DevSwat IDE](https://dev-swat.com/download-ide): AI-powered code editor with code execution intelligence, terminal, live preview, and project management.
- [OpenClaw](https://dev-swat.com/download-openclaw): Local-first federated agent connector. 137 tools across 15 categories. Tools run on YOUR machine, data never leaves your hardware.
- [Code Visualizer](https://dev-swat.com/code-visualizer): AST/SAST code analysis. GitHub repo scanning, dependency graphs, function tracing, dead code detection, governance reports.
- [Resonant Memory](https://dev-swat.com/products/memory): physics-informed AI memory API, pay-per-call. 9-layer cognitive architecture. Embedding-based retrieval with resonance clustering.
- [ResonantChat](https://dev-swat.com): Personalized AI chat intelligence with hallucination detection, evidence graphs, neural skill classification, and smart routing that reduces LLM token costs.
- [Platform Connectors](https://dev-swat.com/integrations): Connect any LLM provider and any external platform — Google Drive, Gmail, Slack, deployments, and more. Unlimited.

## LLM Providers

Connect any LLM provider — not limited to a fixed list. Built-in support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, Mistral AI, Cohere, Ollama (local), and more. Smart routing automatically selects the best model and reduces token costs.

## Governance

- [RARA Governance](https://dev-swat.com/products/governance): Invariant enforcement, capability decay, kill switch, compliance profiles (SOC2, EU AI Act).
- [Neural Routing](https://dev-swat.com/products/neural-routing): Trained MLP classifier routes messages to 14 specialized skills in ~5ms. Active learning.

## Use Cases

- [For Developers](https://dev-swat.com/use-cases/developers): AI pair programming, agents, code analysis, unlimited LLM providers, smart routing.
- [For Teams](https://dev-swat.com/use-cases/teams): Multi-agent teams, shared memory, RARA governance, audit trails.
- [For Security](https://dev-swat.com/use-cases/security): SAST scanning, invariant enforcement, compliance reporting.
- [For Automation](https://dev-swat.com/use-cases/automation): Scheduled agents, webhooks, visual workflows, integrations.

## Comparisons

- [vs Cursor](https://dev-swat.com/compare/devswat-vs-cursor): AI autocomplete IDE vs full agentic platform.
- [vs Windsurf](https://dev-swat.com/compare/devswat-vs-windsurf): Both have agentic coding; DevSwat adds a full agent platform and governance layer.
- [vs ChatGPT](https://dev-swat.com/compare/devswat-vs-chatgpt): Chat assistant vs autonomous agent infrastructure.
- [vs Replit](https://dev-swat.com/compare/devswat-vs-replit): Cloud IDE vs production AI infrastructure.

## Documentation

- [Architecture](https://dev-swat.com/docs/architecture): Full platform infrastructure, service topology, technical deep dive.
- [Agent API](https://dev-swat.com/docs/agent-api): REST API for creating, running, scheduling agents.
- [Governance Protocol](https://dev-swat.com/docs/governance-protocol): RARA invariants, capability grammar, mutation executor.
- [Resonant Memory](https://dev-swat.com/products/memory): physics-informed 12-D hash-sphere memory API — gravity retrieval, associative mesh, multi-hop fact graph, temporal reasoning, isolated per user/agent/org.
- [Neural Routing Docs](https://dev-swat.com/docs/neural-routing): MLP classifier, training pipeline, active learning.
